# Ground Truth Environment

Treat ports, versions, paths, and service endpoints as unknown until confirmed from files or commands.

## Startup checks

When failures smell environmental, note cwd, user, and interpreter or runtime versions that matter.

## Discovery over defaults

Probe configuration and health surfaces instead of assuming standard ports or implicit credentials.

## Scoped mutations

When you must change the environment for an experiment, keep changes minimal and revert when practical.
